notes.title: Update Notes for 1. July 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added [b]trident spear[/b] (replaces the persistent javelin in some levels)
[*] added a [b]new podium screen[/b] menu (let's you switch map, or restart the current one)
[*] javelins only appear in chests now
[*] fixed podium-skip-bug when attacking while the round is over
[*] fixed not getting any points in marathon mode if there are less players in game than gamepads connected
[*] fixed a missing sprite (right in the middle of map 5)
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes incoming!
notes.content: [h2]My engine broke![/h2][p]After having a little shock at new years, that GameMaker does not start anymore and all reinstalls and registry, license server shenanigens did not work at all. Thinking that the game remains as is - working but with some bugs I wanted to fix.  [b]I somehow got it working again![/b] Which is great. I was in the middle of working on a new Podiumscreen with better choice for restarting, going back to the lobby or switching map. On the side I could [b]fix[/b] some nasty [b]bugs[/b] (details will follow in the update announcement) [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235702/f6fadd0d35027bca1def9615ed51e6fcce2a74da.png"][/img][/p][h2]Going places![/h2][p]I released the game at [b]Kokorokon[/b] in February this year. That was really nice. Coming together with the other devs and pressing the green button. Then showed it at the [b]Austria Comic Con[/b] in April, last weekend at [b]LevelUp[/b] Salzburg and this weekend it will be available to play for free on site at [b]A1 eSports Festival[/b] in vienna! The fact that I can now fix bugs again is reassuring. With all the exhibits at the expos, I was already sad that I couldn't continue working. [/p][h2]First deep discount![/h2][p]Also: the game is on [b]sale[/b] right now! If you are on the fence, get it now and enjoy the new update in a few days![/p]
